children.text: Bug: timeline density loses issue context

attrs.class: text-muted-foreground flex flex-col gap-5 text-[15px] leading-6

children.text: When the project timeline is filtered down to a focused sprint, the issue bars keep their dates but lose the parent issue context. The result is still editable, but it is difficult to tell whether a row belongs to the parent planning track or to a nested follow-up issue.
Here you can see the nested timeline issue still appears in the direct planning view, but the same issue loses its parent marker after switching to the compact calendar view:
